status.en: 22 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 35% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa.
status.nb: 22 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 35 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa.

summary.en: Ethiopian forces have seized a key town in Tigray and its regional airport and are moving toward an Eritrean border town, while fighting in Amhara has left at least 183 dead, according to the UN. The United States has stepped up diplomatic pressure and urged de-escalation as the conflict spreads. Leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia are meeting to coordinate security operations if the fighting crosses borders. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske styrker har tatt kontroll over en viktig by i Tigray og dens regionale flyplass, og beveger seg mot en eritreisk grenseby, mens kampene i Amhara har etterlatt minst 183 døde, ifølge FN. USA har økt diplomatisk press og oppfordret til de-eskalering ettersom konflikten sprer seg. Ledere fra Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan og Somalia møtes for å koordinere sikkerhetsoperasjoner dersom kampene krysser grenser. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
